**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Mortgage Logic.com. In fact, § 2(a) affirmatively preserves our freedom to "acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and our § 10 confidentiality obligations. That sits above the playbook's preferred position.

The § 8 Client covenants are limited to legal compliance, non-misrepresentation of underwriting decisions, access control, content warranties and anti-spam — none constrains our business or product choices.

One diligence note (not a deviation): § 8(d) incorporates a separate "Non-Competition Agreement" as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data. That restriction runs against the counterparty and benefits us, so it is not flagged, but the separate agreement is not attached and should be reviewed to confirm it contains no reciprocal restriction binding us.
